name: storage-reclaim
description: Disk cleanup for macOS that leads with a ranked table of quick wins, skips anything a process or another agent session is using, and deletes only what you approve. Bundles disk-map, a read-only treemap and what-grew diff for any disk.

project_roots.title: Project folders
project_roots.description: Colon-separated folders that hold your repos, for example ~/code:~/work. Empty means whichever of ~/Documents, ~/Projects, ~/code, ~/Developer and ~/src exist.

idle_days.title: Idle after (days)
idle_days.description: A project with no commit, file edit or agent session for this many days counts as idle, so its installs and build output go into the rec set.

lock_dir.title: Lock directory name
lock_dir.description: Name of a folder your sessions use to mark active work (for example .locks). While it holds a file, nothing in that project is proposed. Leave empty if you have none.

worktree_suffix.title: Worktree folder suffix
worktree_suffix.description: Folders whose name ends with this text (for example -worktrees) hold other sessions' worktrees and are never proposed. Leave empty if you have none.
